title: What Is Ectopic Pregnancy Surgery?
description: What ectopic pregnancy surgery (salpingectomy/salpingostomy) is, what it is for and when it is recommended. Care in Lima with price alternatives.
tldr: It treats a pregnancy that implants outside the uterus (usually in the fallopian tube); it is often an emergency. The specialist decides the indication; results vary from person to person.
bodyHtml:
It treats a pregnancy that implants outside the uterus (usually in the fallopian tube); it is often an emergency.

How is it done?

Laparoscopy to remove the ectopic pregnancy, preserving the fallopian tube when possible.

When is it recommended?

A confirmed ectopic pregnancy, especially with pain or instability. It is a gynecological emergency.

At Cirugía 24 Horas

We operate in Lima with the same team across different clinics, so you can choose the price alternative that fits you. We also care for patients from abroad.
